target.title: fix(agents): keep truncation surrogate-safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes two user-visible truncation paths that could split UTF-16 surrogate pairs and leak replacement characters in agent-facing text. Background bash session labels and `web_fetch` text truncation now stay emoji-safe at the truncation boundary.

## Why This Change Was Made

Both paths truncated strings with raw `.slice()` even though nearby code has already standardized on `truncateUtf16Safe` for user-facing bounded text. This patch aligns those sibling paths with the existing safe truncation contract and adds focused regression coverage for surrogate-pair boundaries.

## User Impact

Users no longer see broken emoji or replacement characters in compact background bash session labels or truncated `web_fetch` text output when a boundary lands inside a surrogate pair.

## Evidence

- Focused regression tests added in `src/agents/bash-process-references.test.ts` and `src/agents/tools/web-fetch-utils.test.ts`
- Validation command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/web-fetch-utils.test.ts src/agents/bash-process-references.test.ts`
- Real terminal output:
